description: This file is a shell script (`start-backend.sh`) that manages starting a backend server environment for a bookstore application. It primarily attempts to start a PHP built-in server, falling back to a Node.js placeholder server, then to busybox httpd, and finally to netcat or a sleep loop if no suitable server tools are available.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a timestamped message with the prefix [start-backend].

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal error message and exits the script.
